ai.rationale: Sharp, complete jumbotron fan-cam concept tied to a specific team (Celtics): QR → selfie → Green/Mean → Claude Vision scoring energy/spirit/originality → AI-generated PA-announcer roast lines → operator dashboard queues winners for the big screen. Real multimodal AI use, two-surface product (audience + operator), and all URLs present including a slide deck. Slight knock for the ngrok-hosted deploy (transient rather than a permanent URL), and the entertainment-only use case caps it short of the top tier, but the depth of build for one day is clearly above the median.
